titulo: What Happens to a Moth That Circles Your Porch Light All Night?
titulos_alternativos: Moths Don't Love the Light. They're Trapped
Why Moths Spin Around Your Porch Light (Scientists Finally Know)
descripcion:
A warm summer night. You flip on the porch light and within minutes, they arrive. Dozens of moths, spinning around the bulb, never landing, never leaving. So what happens to a moth that circles your porch light all night long? And why can't it just fly away?

What a 2024 study filmed in 3D finally revealed, the built-in autopilot that keeps insects right side up, why a bulb turns it into a trap, who is waiting for the moths at dawn, why it matters for the flowers in the dark, and the easy fixes for your porch.
